verdict.rationale: Jan is a chat/agent interface for local and cloud LLMs with MCP/tool-use and file/command/web-research agentic capabilities, but there is no evidence of an integrated document workspace (e.g., a canvas/editor) where an agent drafts and edits documents with autosave. The closest features (assistants, chat, MCP, autonomous tasks) do not describe document authoring/editing UX.
